title: (Pwn2Own) NVIDIA GPU Display Drivers TLS State Deadlock Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of NVIDIA GPU Display Drivers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system, even if only within a container, in order to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of IRQL_RAISED flags. A crafted IOCTL request can create a deadlock on a worker thread. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the target host system.
addtionnal_details:
NVIDIA has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5821
